verses.sanskrit: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् | देवीं सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ||
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam | devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet ||
verses.translation: Having bowed to Narayana and Nara, the best of men, and to the goddess Sarasvati — then let one recite the word Jaya (victory).
verses.hindi: नारायण को, नर (सर्वोत्तम मनुष्य) को, और देवी सरस्वती को प्रणाम करके — तब "जय" शब्द का उच्चारण करे।
verses.commentary: The traditional opening of the Mahabharata and Harivamsha — identical because both emerge from Vyasa's vision of the totality of dharma. "Jaya" (victory) is the original title of the Mahabharata. The invocation to Narayana (divine consciousness), Nara (the best human — the realized man), and Sarasvati (wisdom/speech) sets the frame: this text is about the intersection of divine and human, and it can only be understood with the help of wisdom. To begin any great undertaking with this invocation is to align yourself with all three.

verses.sanskrit: एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढः सर्वव्यापी सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा | कर्माध्यक्षः सर्वभूताधिवासः साक्षी चेता केवलो निर्गुणश्च ||
verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā | karmādhyakṣaḥ sarvabhūtādhivāsaḥ sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśca ||
verses.translation: One God hidden in all beings, all-pervading, the inner self of all beings; the overseer of all actions, the dwelling of all beings, the witness, the consciousness, the one alone, beyond all qualities.
verses.hindi: एक ही देव सब प्राणियों में छिपे हैं; सर्वव्यापी, सब प्राणियों के अन्तरात्मा; सब कर्मों के अध्यक्ष, सब प्राणियों के निवास-स्थान; साक्षी, चेतना, एकाकी और निर्गुण।
verses.commentary: Quoted in the Harivamsha's cosmological preamble (originally from Shvetashvatara Upanishad VI.11), this verse names the seven attributes of the one reality hidden in everything. "Sakshi" (the witness) is perhaps the most psychologically significant: the divine is not an actor but an observer — the pure awareness within every experience that itself remains untouched. To recognize the sakshi in oneself is the goal of the entire Harivamsha's teaching.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णस्तु भगवान् साक्षात् द्वापरान्ते कलौ युगे | प्रादुर्भूतो महायोगी विष्णुः परमकारणम् ||
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇastu bhagavān sākṣāt dvāparānte kalau yuge | prādurbhūto mahāyogī viṣṇuḥ paramakāraṇam ||
verses.translation: Krishna himself, the Lord, appeared at the end of Dvapara and the beginning of Kali Yuga — the great yogi, Vishnu, the supreme cause.
verses.hindi: कृष्ण स्वयं भगवान्, द्वापर के अंत और कलियुग के आरम्भ में प्रकट हुए — महायोगी, विष्णु, परम कारण।
verses.commentary: The Harivamsha's theological statement: Krishna is not an ordinary avatar but Bhagavan himself — the supreme person appearing in history. "Prādurbhūtaḥ" — manifested, not born in the ordinary sense. "Mahāyogī" — the great yogi, the master of all powers. "Paramakāraṇam" — the supreme cause, the ground of all being. This is the Harivamsha's answer to the question: who was Krishna? Not merely a teacher, not merely a king — the supreme cause taking form.
verses.wordMeaning: The Harivamsha's theological statement: Krishna is not an ordinary avatar but Bhagavan himself — the supreme person appearing in history. verses.sanskrit: अनेन सत्येन सुखी भव | धर्मेण वर्धस्व | कल्याणमस्तु ते नित्यम् ||
verses.transliteration: anena satyena sukhī bhava | dharmeṇa vardhasva | kalyāṇamastu te nityam ||
verses.translation: By this truth, be happy. Grow by dharma. May auspiciousness be yours always.
verses.hindi: इस सत्य के द्वारा सुखी हो। धर्म से बढ़ो। तुम्हारा सदा कल्याण हो।
verses.commentary: Spoken in the context of Nanda and Yashoda's celebration of Krishna's birth — a benediction that distills the Harivamsha's vision of the good life into three movements: truth as foundation, dharma as growth, and auspiciousness as the result. The Vishnu Parva surrounding Krishna's birth is not a fairy tale — it is a philosophical argument: when the divine enters the world in the form of pure joy (Krishna's lila), the response of the truly wise is exactly this — to seek truth, to act righteously, and to find the resulting life genuinely good.

verses.sanskrit: गोवर्धनं गिरिवरं हस्तेनैकेन लीलया | उत्पाट्य धारयामास मेघच्छत्रमिवाचलम् ||
verses.transliteration: govardhanam girivaram hastenaikena līlayā | utpāṭya dhārayāmāsa meghacchatramivācalam ||
verses.translation: He uprooted Govardhana — the best of mountains — with one hand, effortlessly as play, and held it like an umbrella of clouds above the immovable peak.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने पर्वतश्रेष्ठ गोवर्धन को एक ही हाथ से खेल-खेल में उखाड़कर, मेघमय छत्र की तरह, अविचल धारण किया।
verses.commentary: The Govardhan-lifting episode is the Harivamsha's central theological statement about devotion (bhakti) vs. fear-based religion. Indra's storm — the old religion of appeasing wrathful gods — is defeated by Krishna holding the mountain as shelter for his people. "Lilaya" (effortlessly as play) is the key word: what requires immense effort from the limited self is effortless for the Self aligned with the infinite. The cow-herders sheltered under the mountain are all of us — sheltered when we take refuge not in fear but in love.

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत | अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ||
verses.transliteration: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata | abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham ||
verses.translation: Whenever and wherever dharma declines, O Bharata, and whenever adharma rises — at that time I manifest myself.
verses.hindi: हे भारत! जब-जब धर्म की हानि होती है और अधर्म का उत्थान होता है — तब-तब मैं अपने आपको प्रकट करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: This is the most famous verse from the Bhagavad Gita (4.7), quoted within the Bhavishya Parva's prophetic context — which gives it a different dimension. In the Harivamsha, it is not a philosophical teaching but an active promise embedded in history: Krishna's own birth and the narrative of the entire text is the fulfilment of this promise. The Harivamsha is the "sambhavami yuge yuge" made visible — the divine actually showing up, in specific human detail.

verses.sanskrit: हरिवंशं पुराणं च श्रुत्वा सर्वाघनाशनम् | विष्णोः पदं प्राप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ||
verses.transliteration: harivāṃśaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śrutvā sarvāghanāśanam | viṣṇoḥ padaṃ prāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
verses.translation: Having heard the Harivamsha Purana — the destroyer of all sins — one attains the abode of Vishnu. There should be no doubt about this.
verses.hindi: हरिवंश पुराण को सुनने से — जो सभी पापों का नाशक है — विष्णु के पद की प्राप्ति होती है। इसमें कोई संशय नहीं करना चाहिए।
verses.commentary: The Harivamsha's own mahatmya — the glory of the text itself. In Sanskrit scriptural tradition, every major Purana ends with a statement about the merit of hearing it. But the Harivamsha's claim is deeper than merit-accumulation: "vishnoḥ padaṃ" — the abode of Vishnu — is the state of consciousness in which one recognizes the all-pervading divine in every form, including one's own. To truly hear the Harivamsha is to undergo the journey from genealogy (birth, lineage, time) to the timeless — from the story of Hari to the recognition of Hari within.

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिच्याधिराज्ये तु पृथुं वैन्यं पितामहः ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि व्यादेष्टुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: abhiṣicyādhirājye tu pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ pitāmahaḥ tataḥ krameṇa rājyāni vyādeṣṭum upacakrame
verses.translation: Janamejaya said:—Having installed Prithu the son of Vena, in the office of the Lord Paramount the Patriarch began to confer kingdoms on Soma and others (1). He placed Soma in charge of the twice-born, herbs, planets, stars, sacrifices and hard austerities (2). He then installed Varuna as the king of waters, Vaishravana as the lord of kings, Vishnu the king of Adityas, Pāvaka the king of Vasus, Laksha the king of Patriarchs, Vāsava the king of Maruts, Pralhāda of incomperable energy the king of Daityas, and and Danavas, Yama, the offspring of the sun, as the king of the departed manes, Nārāyana as the king of Mātris, vows, Mantrās, kine, Yakshas, Rākshasas and kings and Siva, having the emblem of a bull, as the king of Sādhyas and Rudras (3–7). He then ordered Viprachitta to become the king of the Dānavas and made Girisha (Siva) the holder of mace, the king of all ghosts and goblins (8). He made Himavān, the king of mountains, and the ocean the king of rivers and appointed the greatly power Vāyu as the king of smell, bodiless creatures, sound, ether and earth (9). He made the lord Chitraratha the king of Gandarvas, Vāsuki, the king of Nāgas and Takshaka the king of serpents (10). He ordered Airavat to become the king of the elephants, Ushaishrava, of the horses and Garuda the king of birds, tiger the king of beasts and the bull, the king kine, Plaksha the king of trees, and, installed Parjanya as the king of ocean, rivers, showers and Adityas (11—13). He installed Sesha as the king of wild animals and Takshaka, the king of reptiles and serpents (14). He made Kāmadeva the king of Gandharvas and Asuras and Samvatsara the king of seasons, months, days, fortnights, moments, conjunctions of planets, Parvas, Kālas, Kāshthās, Pramāsha, Ayanas, Mathematics and all conjunctions. Having divided the kingdom in such an order Brahmā placed all the guardians of the quarters. He installed Sudhanna, the son of the Patriarch Vairaja as the Protector of the eastern quarter. He placed in the South the high-souled Sankhapāda, the son of the Patriarch Kardama. He installed the high-souled Ketuman, the son of Raja, as the king of the West. And he made the irrepressible, Hirany roma, the son of the Patriarch Prajanya, the king of the North. Even now they have been piously ruling over their respective provinces of the earth consisting of seven insular continents and mountains. By all those kings Prithu was appointed as the Lord Pāramonnt in a Rajshuya sacrifice according to rites laid down in the Vedas, O king (15–23). After the expiration of the highly vigorous Manwantara of Chakshusha the Patriarch Brahmā conferred the kingdom on Manu Vaivaswata. If you wish to listen, O sinless king, I shall give you at length an account (of his life) for your help. This has been described fully in Purana. It is sacred and confers fame, longevity, residence in heaven and auspicious
verses.hindi: पृथुका उपाख्यान--राज्यवितरण और दिक्पालोंकी प्रतिष्ठा यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोम॑ राज्ये3भ्यषेचयत् अपां तु वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं प्रभुम्। बृहस्पतिं तु विश्वेषां ददावाड़िरसं पतिम् भूगूणामधिपं चैव काव्यं राज्येडभ्यषेचयत् । आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम्।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वीरुधां चैव नक्षत्रग्रहयोस् तथा यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: dvijānāṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva nakṣatragrahayos tathā yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva somaṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: Janamejaya said:—O Vaishampāyana, do thou describe in full, the birth of Prithu and how by that high-souled one this earth was milched (26); how was she milched by the ancestral manes, gods, Rishis, Daityas, Nagas, Yakshas, serpents, mountains, Pishachas, Gandharvas, the leading Brāhmanas, Rakshasas, and other great creatures, (27–28). Do thou also describe fully, O Vaishampāyana, their various vessels, the calves and the various articles in order, for which she was milched (29). Do thou also relate, why formerly Vena's arm was churned by the angry Rishis
verses.hindi: हैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्मदममितौजसम् वैशम्पायनजी कहते हैं--राजन्! पितामह (मैं विराजमान हरि) -ने राजाओंके ऊपर भी अधिराजारूपसे बेनके पुत्र पृुथुका अभिषेक किया, फिर (उन प्रजापतिने) क्रमश: राज्यका वितरण आरम्भ किया ॥ १ ॥ (प्रजापतिने ) द्विज, लता, नक्षत्र, ग्रह, यज्ञ और तपके राज्यपर चन्द्रमाका अभिषेक किया॥ २॥ जलके राज्यपर वरुणका तथा राजाओं (और यक्षों)-के राज्यपर विश्रवाके पुत्र कुबेरका अभिषेक कर दिया। विश्वेदेवोंपर आड्रिरसगोत्री बृहस्पतिको राजा बना दिया॥ ३ ॥ भृगुवंशियोंके स्वामीरूपसे शुक्राचार्यका राज्याभिषेक कर दिया। आदित्योंके ऊपर विष्णुको और वसुओंके ऊपर अग्रिको (राजा बना दिया) ॥ ४॥ दक्षको प्रजापतियोंका, इन्द्रको मरुतोंका तथा अमित पराक्रमी

verses.sanskrit: अपां तु वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं पतिम् बृहस्पतिं तु विश्वेषां ददाव् आङ्गिरसं पतिम् ॥ भृगूणाम् अधिपं चैव काव्यं राज्ये ऽभिषेचयत् । आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनाम् अथ पावकम्
verses.transliteration: apāṃ tu varuṇaṃ rājye rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ patim bṛhaspatiṃ tu viśveṣāṃ dadāv āṅgirasaṃ patim || bhṛgūṇām adhipaṃ caiva kāvyaṃ rājye 'bhiṣecayat | ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnām atha pāvakam
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—O Janamejaya, listen, with attention and concentrated mind, I shall give you a detailed account of Prithu, the son of Vena (31). O monarch, I do not describe this unto him, who is impure, little-witted, who is not a worthy disciple, who does not observe vows, who is ungrateful and injures people (32). O king, do thou listen duly to this theme described by the god-like Rishis which secures heaven, longevity, fame and riches (for all) (33). He, who having saluted the Brāhmanas daily, listens to the birth story of Vena's son, Prithu, does not grieve for iniquities committed by him (34).
verses.hindi: प्रह्मादको हैत्य और दानवोंका राजा बना दिया एवं पितरोंके राज्यपर विवस्वान् (सूर्य)-के पुत्र यमका अभिषेक कर दिया॥ ५5 ॥षोडशमातृका, ब्रत, मन्त्र, गौ, यक्ष, राक्षस, पार्थिव पदार्थ और साध्य देवताओंके राज्यपर नारायणका अभिषेक कर दिया और रुद्रोंके राज्यपर वृषभध्वज (शंकरजी) अभिषिक्त हुए विप्रचित्तिं तु राजानं दानवानामथादिशत्। विप्रचित्तिको दानवोंका राजा बननेका आदेश दे

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु मरुताम् अथ वासवम् दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादम् अमितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ tu marutām atha vāsavam daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca prahlādam amitaujasam
verses.translation: Vaishampāyana said:—Formerly the Patriarch Anga, born in the race of Atri, and equally all-powerful like him, became the protector of religion (1). A highly impious son by name Vena was born to him. That Patriarch was begotten on Sunithā the daughter of Death (2). Imbibing the defect of his maternal grand-father, that son of Kāla's daughter deviated from his own duties and preached freedom of conduct in the world (3). That king established an irreligious order and disregarding Vedic observances he engaged in impious actions (4). During his administration the study of the Vedas and the performance of the Vedic rites were suspended. And the celestials did not get Soma juice consecrated in Yajnas (5). Such was the dreadful promise of the Patriarch that no one would perform, even at the time of destruction, either Homa or Yajna (6). O foremost of Kurus, (he said) I am worthy of being adored, I am the agent of Yajna, I am identical with Yajna—you should dedicate all your Yajnas and Homas unto me (7). Beholding him thus transgress the order and partake unduly and unfairly of the sacrificial offerings the great Rishis, headed by Marichi, said (8):–"We shall enter upon the initiation ceremony for many long years—therefore do not act irreligiously, O Vena, for such is the eternal religion (9). After the death of Atri you have forsooth been born as a Patriarch. And you made the contract that you would govern the subjects" (10). After they had said this the wicked and ill-disposed Vena, laughing, said to all those great Rishis, the following evil words (11). Vena said "Who else will be the founder of religion? Whom shall I hear? Who else is superior to me on this earth in learning, energy, prowess, asceticism and truth (12)? All creatures and especially all forms of religion have originated from me. You are all stupid and void of consciousness and therefore you do not know me (13). If I wish I can burn down the earth or overflow it with water. I can obstruct the heaven and earth: there is no need of discussing it (14)". When the noble Rishis could not make Vena humble on account of his pride and egotism, they, worked up with anger, belaboured that highly powerful king and began to churn his left thigh (15–16). When the thigh of that king was thus churned there arose from it a greatly short and dark person (17). O Janamejaya, he stood there, stricken with fear and folding his arms. Beholding him thus possessed by fear Atri said to him "Nishida" _Sit down_ (18). O foremost of speakers, he became the originator of the race of Nishadas (hunters) and procreated the race of fishermen begotten of the sins of Vena (19). And Tukhāras, Tumuras and other races taking delight in impiety who live on the Vindhya mountain were also born of Vena (20). Thereupon, those high-souled Rishis, worked up with anger, began to churn the right arm of Vena like a piece of wood used for kindling fire (21). From that arm originated Prithu resembling the very flame, and burning in effulgence like the fire itself (22). The highly illustrious Prithu was born with his most excellent prime bow _Ajagava_, heavenly arrows and a highly lustrous coat of mail to protect his body (23-24). At his birth all the creatures were filled with delight and Vena too, O monarch, repaired to the celestial region (25). O descendant of Kuru, the great Prithu, a good son, being born he saved Vena from the hell called _Put_¹¹ (26). Taking all the jewels the oceans came to him with water for his installation (27). The Divine Brahmā with the Devas, the offspring of Angiras, and all other creatures, mobile and immobile, came there and installed the effulgent king, the son of Vena, the lord of an extensive kingdom (28-29). The highly energetic and powerful son of Vena, Prithu, was installed as the first king by the leading Rishis conversant with the Vedas and other scriptures (30) By him were pleased the subjects who had been dissatisfied by his father. On account of his being the object of their love he was called Rājā (king) (31). When he used to make a voyage in the ocean the water used be grow hard as land and the mountains made way for him and the branches of the trees were not broken down (32). The earth grew easy of production and yielded articles of food as soon as thought of. The kine gave milk whenever milched and honey grew in every leaf (33). In the meantime at the sacred Yajna of Brahmā, was born the highly intelligent Suta (34). At that great Yajna was also born the wise Māgadha. They were invited by the celestial saints for chanting the glories of Prithu (35). All the Rishis said to them "Do ye sing the glories of this king. This is a work that befits you and this king too is also an worthy subject for it (36)". Then Suta and Māgadha said to all those Rishis:—"We shall, with our own actions, delight the gods and Rishis (37). O ye twice born ones, we are not cognizant of the actions, characteristics and fame of this energetic king. How shall we then chant his glories (38)?" They were then engaged by the Rishis (to chant his glories) saying "Do ye chant his glories by the deeds which the highly powerful Prithu did in the previous Kalpa (39). This king speaks truth, has a good character, keeps his promise, is modest, does good unto all, is forgiving, powerful, represses the wicked, observes his duties, is grateful, merciful, always speaks sweet words and respects those who deserve it, performs Yajnas, is devoted to Brāhmanas, is of a quiet temperament, and observes the rules of society." Since then, O Janmejaya, at the time of chanting glories Sutas and Māgadhas (panegyrists) pour their benedictions in this world (40-42). Being highly pleased with their eulogy the king Prithu conferred upon Suta the province of Arupa, and on Māgadha, that of Magadha (43). Thereat delighted the great Rishis and the subjects said "The king will forsooth grant us maintenances in abundance (44)". Thereupon at the words of the great saints, the subjects approached the son of Vena and begged of him their maintenances (45). Thus approached by his subjects and with a view to do them good the powerful king took up his bow and assailed the earth (46). Thereupon assuming the form of a cow the earth fled away in fear of Vena's son. Prithu too, taking up his bow, pursued her (47). Traversing the region of Brahmā and all other regions in fear of Vena's son she saw him everywhere before her with the bow in his hand (48). He looked effulgent like the burning eternal fire with his sharpened arrows and even the immortals could not repress that high-souled one (49). Even when repairing to the region of Brahmā she could not find safety; the earth, adored even by the three worlds with folded hands then said to the son of Vena:—"You should not perpetrate the iniquity of slaying a woman. Without me, how will you be able, O king, to protect your subjects (50-51). O king, all the worlds are situated on me, and this universe is sustained by me. Know this, O king, that with my destruction all the creatures will be destroyed (52). O king, if you wish to encompass the well being of your subjects it does not behove you to kill me. Listen to these words of mine (53). If works are undertaken commensurate with their means they are crowned with success. Do you, O king, find out the means by which you will protect your subjects (54). By slaying me, O king, you will not be able to protect your subjects by any means. O you of great effulgence, I will find it out; do you restrain your anger (55). Even women of inferior births should not be slain. Therefore, O king, you should not forsake your morality (56)."
verses.hindi: सर्वभूतपिशाचानां गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्॥ ८  दिया और सकल भूत-पिशाचोंका शूलपाणि महादेवजीको शब्दाकाशवतां चैव वायुं च बलिनां वरम् वारणानां च राजानमैरावतमथादिशत्। उच्चैःश्रवसमश्चानां गरुडं चेव पक्षिणाम् वनस्पतीनां राजानं प्लक्षमेवादिशत् प्रभुम्

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च यमं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत् मातॄणां च व्रतानां च मन्त्राणां च तथा गवाम् । यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पार्थिवानां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vaivasvataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca yamaṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayat mātṝṇāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ ca tathā gavām | yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Hearing those various words of the earth the high-souled and pious king, restraining his anger, said to her (57).
verses.hindi: सर्वेषां द्रंष्टिणां शेषं राजानमभ्यषेचयत्। सरीसपाणां सर्पाणां राजानं चैव तक्षकम् गन्धर्वाप्सरसां चैव कामदेवं तथा प्रभुम्। ऋतूनामथ मासानां दिवसानां तथेव च कलाकाष्षटाप्रमाणानां गतेरयनयोस्तथा दिशापालं सुधन्वानं राजानं चाभ्यषेचयत्। दक्षिणस्यां महात्मानं कर्दमस्य प्रजापते:

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं तु साध्यानां रुद्राणां वृषभध्वजम् । विप्रचित्तिं तु राजानं दानवानाम् अथादिशत् । सर्वभूतपिशाचानाम् गिरीशं शूलपाणिनम् शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनाम् अथ सागरम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ tu sādhyānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam | vipracittiṃ tu rājānaṃ dānavānām athādiśat | sarvabhūtapiśācānām girīśaṃ śūlapāṇinam śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nadīnām atha sāgaram
verses.translation: ¹¹ It is a hell where all those who have no son born to them go after death. It is for this that the Hindus look so eagerly to the birth
verses.hindi: पुत्रं शब्डुघदं नाम राजानं सो5भ्यषेचयत्। पश्चिमायां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम् केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं सो5भ्यषेचयत्। तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापते: उदीच्यां दिशि दुर्धर्ष राजानं सो5भ्यषेचयत् । तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता यथाप्रदेशमद्यापि धर्मेण परिपाल्यते।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धानां मरुतां चैव भूतानाम् अशरीरिणाम् । शब्दाकाशवतां चैव वायुं च बलिनां वरम् । गन्धर्वाणाम् अधिपतिं चक्रे चित्ररथं प्रभुः नागानां वासुकिं चक्रे सर्पाणाम् अथ तक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: gandhānāṃ marutāṃ caiva bhūtānām aśarīriṇām | śabdākāśavatāṃ caiva vāyuṃ ca balināṃ varam | gandharvāṇām adhipatiṃ cakre citrarathaṃ prabhuḥ nāgānāṃ vāsukiṃ cakre sarpāṇām atha takṣakam
verses.translation: Prithu said:—He, who for one individual destroys many lives either belonging to his own side or to his opposite party, commits a sin in this world (1). By slaying that harmful person at whose death many become happy one is not visited by sin, either great or small (2). If by the destruction of one wicked person the well-being of many is secured such an act leads to the acquisition of virtue (3). I shall therefore, for the behoof of my subjects, kill you, O earth. If you do not satisfy this command of mine conducive to the well-being of the world I shall kill you with this arrow who have neglected my command. And having buried my own self (under the earth) I shall uphold my subjects forever (4-5). O you ever observant of pious rites, do you, during my regeme, give life to my subjects for you are capable of protecting them (6). Do you give milk for me and then I will withdraw the dreadful arrow that I have taken up for your destruction (7).
verses.hindi: राजा बना दिया॥ ८॥ हिमाचलको पर्वतोंका और समुद्रको नदियोंका राजा बना दिया। गन्धद्र॒व्यों, मरुद्रणों, अमूर्त भूतों तथा शब्द और आकाशवाली वस्तुओंके राज्यपर भी बलवानोंमें श्रेष्ठ वायुका अभिषेक कर दिया॥ ९॥ प्रभावशाली चित्ररथको गन्धर्वोका स्वामी बना दिया, वासुकिको नागोंका और तक्षकको सर्पोंका राजा बनाया॥ १०॥ हाथियोंका ऐरावतको, घोड़ोंका उच्चै:अ्रवाकों और पक्षियोंका गरुड़को राजा बना दिया॥ ११॥ वनचारी पशुओंपर सिंहको तथा गौओंपर साँड़को स्वामी बनाया और पाकड़को वृक्षोंका प्रभावशाली राजा बना दिया॥१२॥ सागर, नदी, मेघ, वर्षा और सूर्यकी किरणोंके अधिपतिपदपर पर्जन्यका अभिषेक कर दिया॥ १३॥ दाढ़वाले समस्त सर्पोके ऊपर शेषको, (निर्विष डुण्डुभ आदि) सर्पों और सरीसूपों (पेटके बलपर चलनेवाले जीवों )-के ऊपर तक्षकको राजा बना दिया॥ १४॥ गन्धर्व और अप्सराओंके ऊपर ऐश्वर्यशाली

verses.sanskrit: वारणानां च राजानम् ऐरावतम् अथादिशत् उच्चैःश्रवसम् अश्वानां गरुडं चैव पक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: vāraṇānāṃ ca rājānam airāvatam athādiśat uccaiḥśravasam aśvānāṃ garuḍaṃ caiva pakṣiṇām
verses.translation: Prithu said:—He, who for one individual destroys many lives either belonging to his own side or to his opposite party, commits a sin in this world (1). By slaying that harmful person at whose death many become happy one is not visited by sin, either great or small (2). If by the destruction of one wicked person the well-being of many is secured such an act leads to the acquisition of virtue (3). I shall therefore, for the behoof of my subjects, kill you, O earth. If you do not satisfy this command of mine conducive to the well-being of the world I shall kill you with this arrow who have neglected my command. And having buried my own self (under the earth) I shall uphold my subjects forever (4-5). O you ever observant of pious rites, do you, during my regeme, give life to my subjects for you are capable of protecting them (6). Do you give milk for me and then I will withdraw the dreadful arrow that I have taken up for your destruction (7).
verses.hindi: कामदेवका अभिषेक कर दिया। ऋतु, मास, दिन, पक्ष, रात्रि, मुहूर्त, तिथि, पर्व, कलाकाष्ठाके प्रमाण--उत्तरायण और दक्षिणायनकी गति तथा उपराग अर्थात् ग्रहण (-के अभिमानी देवताओं )-पर प्रभु संवत्सरका अभिषेक कर दिया॥ १५-१६३ ॥ भारत! पितामहने इस प्रकार क्रमपूर्वक राज्योंका विभाग करके फिर दिक्‍पालोंकी स्थापना की थी॥ १७ रे ॥ उन्होंने बैराज प्रजापतिके पुत्र राजा सुधन्वाको पूर्व दिशाके दिक्‍्पालपदपर अभिषेक कर दिया॥ १८ दर ॥ कर्दम प्रजापतिके पुत्र महात्मा राजा शद्डपदको दक्षिण दिशाके दिक्पालपदपर अभिषिक्त किया॥ १ ९३ ॥ इसी प्रकार पश्चिम दिशामें रजसके पुत्र अच्युत महात्मा केतुमान्का राजा (दिक्पाल)-के पदपर अभिषेक कर दिया॥ २ ० ॥ इसी प्रकार उत्तर दिशामें पर्जन्य प्रजापतिके पुत्र दुर्धर्ष हिरण्यरोमाका राजपद (दिक्‍्पालपद)-पर अभिषेक कर दिया॥ २१३॥ उन पुरुषोंद्वारा सातों द्वीप और पर्वतोंसहित सारी पृथ्वी और उसके वे-वे प्रदेश

verses.sanskrit: मृगाणाम् अथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं तु गवाम् अपि वनस्पतीनां राजानं प्लक्षम् एवाभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: mṛgāṇām atha śārdūlaṃ govṛṣaṃ tu gavām api vanaspatīnāṃ rājānaṃ plakṣam evābhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: Prithu said:—He, who for one individual destroys many lives either belonging to his own side or to his opposite party, commits a sin in this world (1). By slaying that harmful person at whose death many become happy one is not visited by sin, either great or small (2). If by the destruction of one wicked person the well-being of many is secured such an act leads to the acquisition of virtue (3). I shall therefore, for the behoof of my subjects, kill you, O earth. If you do not satisfy this command of mine conducive to the well-being of the world I shall kill you with this arrow who have neglected my command. And having buried my own self (under the earth) I shall uphold my subjects forever (4-5). O you ever observant of pious rites, do you, during my regeme, give life to my subjects for you are capable of protecting them (6). Do you give milk for me and then I will withdraw the dreadful arrow that I have taken up for your destruction (7).
verses.hindi: आज भी धर्मानुसार पालित हो रहे हैं॥ २२३॥ जनेश्वर! इन राजाओंने वेदमें वर्णित विधिसे राजसूय यज्ञमें राजाओंके भी राजाके पदपर पृथुका अभिषेक किया था बैवस्वताय मनवे ब्रह्मा राज्यमथादिशत्। तस्य विस्तरमाख्यास्थे मनोरवैवस्वतस्यथ ह तवानुकूल्याद् राजेन्द्र यदि शुश्रूषसेउनघ। महतद्धेग्बवदथिष्ठानं॑ पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्।

verses.sanskrit: सागराणां नदीनां च मेघानां वर्षणस्य च । आदित्यानां अधिपतिं पर्जन्यम् अभिषिक्तवान् ॥ सर्वेषां दंष्ट्रिणां शेषं राजानम् अभ्यषेचयत् । सरीसृपाणां सर्पाणां राजानं चैव तक्षकम् । सर्वाप्सरोगणानां च कामदेवः कृतः प्रभुः ॥ ऋतूनाम् अथ मासानां दिवसानां तथैव च । पक्षाणां च क्षपाणां च मुहूर्ततिथिपर्वणाम् ॥ कलाकाष्ठाप्रमाणानां गतेरयनयोस् तथा । गणितस्याथ योगस्य चक्रे संवत्सरं प्रभुम् । एवं विभज्य राज्यानि क्रमेण स पितामहः दिशां पालान् अथ ततः स्थापयामास भारत
verses.transliteration: sāgarāṇāṃ nadīnāṃ ca meghānāṃ varṣaṇasya ca | ādityānāṃ adhipatiṃ parjanyam abhiṣiktavān || sarveṣāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śeṣaṃ rājānam abhyaṣecayat | sarīsṛpāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ rājānaṃ caiva takṣakam | sarvāpsarogaṇānāṃ ca kāmadevaḥ kṛtaḥ prabhuḥ || ṛtūnām atha māsānāṃ divasānāṃ tathaiva ca | pakṣāṇāṃ ca kṣapāṇāṃ ca muhūrtatithiparvaṇām || kalākāṣṭhāpramāṇānāṃ gaterayanayos tathā | gaṇitasyātha yogasya cakre saṃvatsaraṃ prabhum | evaṃ vibhajya rājyāni krameṇa sa pitāmahaḥ diśāṃ pālān atha tataḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhārata
verses.translation: Prithu said:—He, who for one individual destroys many lives either belonging to his own side or to his opposite party, commits a sin in this world (1). By slaying that harmful person at whose death many become happy one is not visited by sin, either great or small (2). If by the destruction of one wicked person the well-being of many is secured such an act leads to the acquisition of virtue (3). I shall therefore, for the behoof of my subjects, kill you, O earth. If you do not satisfy this command of mine conducive to the well-being of the world I shall kill you with this arrow who have neglected my command. And having buried my own self (under the earth) I shall uphold my subjects forever (4-5). O you ever observant of pious rites, do you, during my regeme, give life to my subjects for you are capable of protecting them (6). Do you give milk for me and then I will withdraw the dreadful arrow that I have taken up for your destruction (7).
verses.hindi: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्गवासकरं शुभम् विस्तरेण पृथोर्जन्म वैशम्पायन कीर्तय। यथा महात्मना तेन दुग्धा चेयं वसुंधरा यथा च पितृभिद्ुग्धा यथा देवैर्यथर्षिभि: । यथा हैत्यैश्व नागैश्व यथा यक्षैर्यथा द्रुमै: तेषां पात्रविशेषांश्व वैशम्पायन कीर्तय। वत्सान् क्षीरविशेषां श्व दोग्धारं चानृपूर्वशः

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमस्यां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम् केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं सो ऽभ्यषेचयत्

verses.hindi: निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारास्तस्मिन् राजनि शासति। प्रवृत्त न पपु: सोम॑ हुतं यज्ञेषु देवताः अहमिज्यश्न यष्टा च यज्ञश्नेति कुरूद्वह। मयि यज्ञों विधातव्यो मयि होतव्यमित्यपि वैशम्पायनजी कहते हैं--राजन्! प्राचीन कालकी बात है, धर्मके रक्षक अत्रिके वंशमें एक प्रजापति उत्पन्न हुए, जिनका नाम था अड्भ। वे अत्रिके ही समान प्रभावशाली थे॥ १॥ उनका पुत्र वेन हुआ, परंतु उसे धर्मके रहस्यका पता न था। वह राजा वेन मृत्युकी पुत्री सुनीथाके गर्भसे उत्पन्न हुआ था॥ २॥ कालकी पुत्री सुनीथाका पुत्र वह बेन नानाके दोषसे अपने धर्मकी उपेक्षा कर कामके कारण लोभमें फँस गया॥ ३॥ वह

If by the destruction of one wicked person the well-being of many is secured such an act leads to the acquisition of virtue (3). I shall therefore, for the behoof of my subjects, kill you, O earth. If you do not satisfy this command of mine conducive to the well-being of the world I shall kill you with this arrow who have neglected my command. And having buried my own self (under the earth) I shall uphold my subjects forever (4-5). O you ever observant of pious rites, do you, during my regeme, give life to my subjects for you are capable of protecting them (6). Do you give milk for me and then I will withdraw the dreadful arrow that I have taken up for your destruction (7).
verses.hindi: राजा धर्मविहीन मर्यादाको स्थापित करने लगा और वेदोक्त धर्मोका उल्लड्रन कर अधर्ममें फँस गया उस राजाके शासनकालमें देवतालोग (उनकी तृप्तिके लिये किये जानेवाले) स्वाध्याय और वषट्कारसे वश्चित हो गये थे; इसलिये अपने उद्देश्यसे अर्पित तथा यज्ञकुण्डोंमें होमे गये सोमका भी वे पान नहीं करते थे॥ ५॥ उसका विनाशकाल समीप आ गया था, अतः उस प्रजापतिने यह क्रूर प्रतिज्ञा घोषित की कि "मेरे राज्यमें कोई यज्ञ और हवन न करे '॥ ६॥ कुरुश्रेष्ठ (वह कहता था कि) 'मैं ही यज्ञोंद्ारा आराध्य और मैं ही यज्ञ करनेवाला हूँ तथा यज्ञ भी मैं ही हूँ। मेरे लिये ही यज्ञ और हवन करना चाहिए'॥ ७॥ जब वह इस प्रकार मर्यादाको तोड़ने लगा और अनुचितरूपसे (कर आदि लगाकर)

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यं स्वर्गवासकरं शुभम् । विस्तरेण पृथोर् जन्म वैशम्पायन कीर्तय यथा महात्मना तेन दुग्धा चेयं वसुंधरा

verses.sanskrit: यथा शैलैः पिशाचैश् च गन्धर्वैश् च द्विजोत्तमैः । राक्षसैश् च महासत्त्वैर् यथा दुग्धा वसुंधरा । तेषां पात्रविशेषांश् च वैशंपायन कीर्तय वत्सान् क्षीरविशेषांश् च सर्वम् एवानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: yathā śailaiḥ piśācaiś ca gandharvaiś ca dvijottamaiḥ | rākṣasaiś ca mahāsattvair yathā dugdhā vasuṃdharā | teṣāṃ pātraviśeṣāṃś ca vaiśaṃpāyana kīrtaya vatsān kṣīraviśeṣāṃś ca sarvam evānupūrvaśaḥ

verses.hindi: पृथुस्तस्मात् समुत्तस्थो कराज्वलनसंनिभ: । दीप्यमान: स्ववपुषा साक्षादग्रिरिव ज्वलन् हम बहुत वर्षोमें पूर्ण होनेवाली दीक्षामें प्रवेश करेंगे। वेन! अब तुम अधर्म न करो; क्‍योंकि यह सनातन धर्म नहीं है॥ ९॥ निःसंदेह तुम इस वंशमें प्रजापतिके रूपमें उत्पन्न हुए हो और तुमने प्रतिज्ञा की थी कि मैं प्रजाका पालन करूँगा'॥ १०॥ जब महर्षि इस प्रकार कह रहे थे, उस समय अनर्थको अपनानेवाले दुर्बुद्धि वेनने हँसकर उन लोगोंसे ये बातें कहीं बेनने कहा-- धर्मका रचनेवाला मेरे सिवा और कौन है ? मैं किसकी बात सुनूँ? इस पृथ्वीपर वेद, वीर्य, तप और सत्यमें मेरे समान दूसरा कौन है?

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिंश् च कारणे पाणिर् वेनस्य मथितः पुरा क्रुद्धैर् महर्षिभिस् तात कारणं तच् च कीर्तय
verses.transliteration: yasmiṃś ca kāraṇe pāṇir venasya mathitaḥ purā kruddhair maharṣibhis tāta kāraṇaṃ tac ca kīrtaya

verses.hindi: आपलोग मूर्ख हैं और अचेत हो रहे हैं, अत: सब भूतोंक और विशेषत: धर्मोके उत्पत्तिस्थान मुझ वेनको नहीं जानते॥ १३॥ मैं चाहूँ तो पृथ्वीको भस्म कर दूँ अथवा इसको जलनमें डुबो दूँ और पृथ्वी तथा आकाशको भी (अपने तेजसे) ढक दूँ; इसमें विचार करनेकी कोई बात नहीं है॥ १४॥ गर्व और मोहके वशमें पड़े हुए उस राजा वेनको जब वे ऋषि अधर्म करनेसे न रोक सके, तब वे क्रोधमें भर गये॥ १५ ॥ फिर तो वे महात्मा उस उछल-कूद मचाते हुए महाबली राजाको बलपूर्वक पकड़कर क्रोधमें भर उसकी दाहिनी जाँघको मथने लगे॥ १६॥ राजाकी उस जड्ढके मथे जानेपर उसमेंसे बहुत ठिगना और बहुत ही काला एक पुरुष निकला॥ १७॥ जनमेजय ! वह डरा हुआ था, अतः हाथ जोड़कर खड़ा हो गया। तब अत्रिने उसे भयसे विह्ल देखकर उससे कहा 'निषीद--बैठ जा'॥ १८ ॥ वक्ताओंमें श्रेष्ठ जनमेजय ! वह निषादोंके वंशका चलानेवाला हुआ

verses.sanskrit: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि पृथोर् वैन्यस्य संभवम् एकाग्रः प्रयतश् चैव शुश्रूषुर् जनमेजय

verses.sanskrit: नाशुचेः क्षुद्रमनसो नाशिष्यस्याव्रतस्य वा कीर्तयेयम् अहं राजन् कृतघ्नस्याहितस्य वा
verses.transliteration: nāśuceḥ kṣudramanaso nāśiṣyasyāvratasya vā kīrtayeyam ahaṃ rājan kṛtaghnasyāhitasya vā

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यं धन्यं वेदेन संमितम् रहस्यम् ऋषिभिः प्रोक्तं शृणु राजन् यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: svargyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ vedena saṃmitam rahasyam ṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ śṛṇu rājan yathātatham

verses.sanskrit: यश् चैनं कीर्तयेन् नित्यं पृथोर् वैन्यस्य संभवम् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य न स शोचेत् कृताकृतम्
verses.transliteration: yaś cainaṃ kīrtayen nityaṃ pṛthor vainyasya saṃbhavam brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya na sa śocet kṛtākṛtam
